# A2.05 Platform and scope definition

## Owner
A2

## Stage
Understand

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-01

## Input (reads)
Manifest, stories, request text

## Steps
1. List target platform: web, mobile, or both.
2. List browsers or OS versions only if the source states them.
3. Write the in-scope and out-of-scope list.
4. Mark gaps TBD

## Output (writes)
Scope statement with in-scope and out-of-scope lists

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/stories/<ID>/scope.md`

## Verification
Every platform line states its source or TBD
